shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide shot, eye-level. The symmetrical composition along the museum hall's central axis includes the tall vaulted ceiling and stone floor. Warm skylight casts soft reflections; it slowly unfolds from a static sphere into a petal-like hand shape, trailing fine fluid trails at its edges. The transition from contraction to expansion is clearly visible. The camera slowly pushes in. Echoes begin first, followed by a soft drumbeat when the hand shape fully opens.

Slightly blurred edges of foreground cases form leading lines. Focus locks onto the liquid metal subject gliding forward along the floor. It transitions from petal hand to wrist-shaped metal wire, continuously flipping in wrist-like arcs, leaving brief reflective trails in the air. Camera subtly pushes in with slight tilt adjustment. Echo tightens as fingertip closes; drumbeat pauses to highlight the gesture.
